mapper.select: SELECT c.contract_id, c.contract_date, c.monthly_equivalent_first_premium, c.payment_term_months, c.standard_surrender_deduction_amount, c.insurer_id, po.product_offering_id, po.channel_code, po.standard_deduction_80_yn, p.product_id, p.product_group_code FROM fgc.insurance_contract c JOIN fgc.product_offering po ON po.product_offering_id = c.product_offering_id JOIN fgc.product p ON p.product_id = po.product_id WHERE c.contract_id = #{contractId}
